title: Foo Fighters drawn to WWII atomic and military programs

tellings.quote: military operations right we know that U are interested in nuclear capabilities and our military capabilities so um what was going on at the height of World War II

plain: The "foo fighters", strange lights that Allied pilots reported over southern Germany in 1944 and 1945, may have been drawn there by wartime atomic and military programmes. A former Pentagon intelligence official named Luis Elizondo suggests this to Michels. He reasons from today's pattern: UAP, the official term for UFOs, seem interested in nuclear and military capabilities, so he asks what was going on at the height of the war. It is his own inference, with no source named.
